purpose: PyPI-only review thresholds; npm keeps each model's global threshold
selection: On training-only 10-fold out-of-fold predictions, choose the lowest threshold with PyPI benign false-positive rate at or below 0.15 and then maximize recall and F1. Test data is used only for the final report.
limitations: This is a post-hoc service policy change and needs a fresh temporal or live-install validation.
Datadog malicious samples may favor GuardDog-like signals.
The score raises review only; it never blocks or relaxes an A decision.
